e: Two-year INFN fellowship at Pavia on precision phenomenology (hadronic corrections to muon g-2, luminosity at future lepton colliders, Drell-Yan/W mass) and Monte Carlo generators. Open to non-Italian citizens with a PhD from a foreign institution, or Italian citizens who have held a position abroad for at least three years; PhD on or after 12 Nov 2018 (PhD needed by 1 Nov 2027).
n: INFN Pavia: Postdoc in high-energy phenomenology (precision calculations)
unv: Host ad link not confirmed; deadline from INFN call 29216.
